other_conditions: Must have participated in games recognized by the School Games Federation of India or included in the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games, Afro‑Asian Games, or Olympics as determined by a government‑appointed committee
Must be below 20 years of age
Must have won state‑level competitions based on sporting achievements
Must have achieved success in junior or sub‑junior open‑category competitions organized by a recognized All India Federation
Must not use banned substances or have any impairment that disqualifies them from participation
Athlete’s sports achievements over the previous two years will be considered for selection
Committee may grant exceptional status for athletes with extraordinary achievements
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹25  lakh per year for Olympic‑level athletes along with equipment, medical coverage, nutrition, psychological support, and training/travel assistance for up to 2‑7 years.
